design: Capture native L1/L4 MLP factors at both value positions. Decompose output delta as Down(deltaLeft*Right + Left*deltaRight + deltaLeft*deltaRight). Add isolated terms, linear sum, full sum, or native output difference to receiver MLP outputs; measure resulting L5H5 local-value readout in a separate pristine receiver run. Audit RMS normalization delta as raw-direction plus scale change.
limitations: Receiver-anchored factor decomposition depends on expansion point and Left/Right parameterization. Individual terms are hybrid interventions; their effects need not sum. Reused exploratory copying panel; not a manifold or whole-task necessity test.
